vr1019034.title: Olympus Tough TG-310 White 14MP Waterproof Digital Camera Tested w/ Battery SD
vr1019034.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1019034.details: Olympus Tough TG-310 rugged compact digital camera in white with a 14 megapixel CCD sensor and a 3.6x optical zoom lens starting at 28 mm wide, rated by the maker as waterproof to 3 m and shockproof to 1.5 m. Condition per the seller: slight scuffs from use and a clean look overall. The seller checked the shutter, flash, autofocus, still and video shooting and saving, and found only a little dust inside the lens, with no mold or haze. The waterproof and shockproof performance was NOT tested, and the seals can age, so please do not rely on the waterproofing without checking them yourself. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera, a strap, a battery (LI-42B), a USB charging cable, a 2 GB SD card, a soft camera case and a lens cloth.
vr1019034.why: A used Olympus Tough TG-310 rugged digital camera in white with a battery, SD card and soft case.
vr1019034.perfect: Outdoor and travel shooters who want a compact rugged camera and do not mind cosmetic wear.
vr1019034.exp: A pre-owned Olympus TG-310 in the condition described above; waterproofing not tested.
